description:
## Objective

Port generated Flow graphs and certify the complete authoring migration.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-04-1255-test-flow-authoring-suite-plan.md`
Unit: `U4`
Covers: `R1-R4`, `R10-R14`, `KTD1-KTD6`

This task adds the missing generated dependency-graph proof and owns final source and quality reconciliation.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: `TBD-U2` for component evidence and `TBD-U3` for source-diagnostic evidence.
- Unblocks: None.

## Branch and integration rule

- Base: `main` after both `TBD-U2` and `TBD-U3` land.
- Combine: Use the integrated outputs from both blockers. Resolve only test-fixture overlap and do not change either slice's public assertions without a recorded deviation.

## Source inventory

- One source `generated_graph_test.exs` with two bounded properties — ported and adapted.
- Complete source corpus: 12 tests, nine support assets, one README, and 60 declared tests or properties plus generated guide cases — reconciled.
- One source `guides_test.exs` — verified as superseded by named current guide and example evidence.

## API and behavior map

- Old generated direct, data, and JSON forms -> current direct, `FlowBuilder`, and version 2 `FlowCodec` forms. Evidence: current Flow helpers.
- Old property replay -> current seed `0` and bounded StreamData runs. Evidence: `test/quality/quality_contract.yml` and `test/property/action_flow/**`.
- Old authoring gate -> consolidated `mix test.authoring`. Evidence: `mix.exs` and `test/test_helper.exs`.

## Files

- Read: fixed `generated_graph_test.exs`, the completed target authoring tree, quality contracts and reports
- Change: `test/authoring/flows/README.md`, `test/quality/source_manifest.yml`, and `test/quality/coverage_baseline.json` only when reconciliation requires an evidence-backed update
- Add: `test/authoring/flows/generated_graph_test.exs`
- Do not change: `lib/**`, `refs/**`, Mix alias semantics, unrelated quality thresholds
- Expected shared changes: final ledger or evidence-only quality metadata updates

## Instructions

1. Port the two bounded generated graph properties with current helpers and stored version 2 data.
2. Reconcile the target README against every fixed source asset and declaration count.
3. Run focused authoring, complete authoring, quality metadata, offline CI, coverage, and final report checks on the integrated tree.
4. Record exact counts, seeds, superseded evidence, and any supported product failure.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Generated valid DAGs match the arithmetic model, exact Action calls, dependency order, and every supported authoring form.
- [ ] Duplicate, unknown-dependency, and cyclic mutations reject in all generated forms with seed replay.
- [ ] All 22 source assets and 60 declarations have a target or named superseded disposition.
- [ ] Agent and Flow authoring tests pass together, and default unit selection remains unchanged.
- [ ] Offline CI, coverage, and quality report pass on the clean integrated revision.
- [ ] No file under `lib/**` or `refs/**` changes.

## Verification

- `mix test.authoring test/authoring/flows --warnings-as-errors` — exits with status 0.
- `mix test.authoring --warnings-as-errors` — exits with status 0.
- `mix test test/quality/source_manifest_test.exs test/quality/component_proof_test.exs --seed 0` — exits with status 0.
- `mix test.ci`, `mix quality.coverage`, and `mix quality.report` — exit with status 0 on the clean integrated revision.
- `mix format --check-formatted` and `git diff --check` — exit with status 0.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source disposition records, exact test counts and seeds, verification results, deviations from the plan, deferred assets, linked follow-up tickets, and remaining blockers.
A product failure must include the exact command, expected result, actual result, and a separate follow-up ticket before this task can close.
title: Reconcile generated Flow authoring proof
